Direct Mail & Printing for Connelly, NY Businesses

Hamlet in Ulster County · ZIP 12417 · Population 400

Back to Ulster County

Why Connelly Businesses Choose Direct Mail

Connelly is a small riverside hamlet in the Town of Esopus sitting directly across the Rondout Creek from Kingston's Rondout waterfront district. Its own ZIP code (12417) covers a very small geographic area — the hamlet and its immediate surroundings — making Connelly one of the more precisely targeted postal areas in Ulster County despite its modest size.

Situated directly on the Rondout Creek across from Kingston's historic Rondout waterfront, accessible via Route 9W and the strand along the creek's western bank.

Local Market Profile: Connelly

Connelly's residential character is working-class and established — homeowners who have lived along the Rondout for generations, with some newer arrivals drawn by proximity to Kingston's growing Rondout waterfront scene across the creek. The hamlet has minimal commercial development of its own; residents access services entirely in Kingston, directly adjacent via the Strand waterfront road. For direct mail purposes, Connelly functions as a Kingston-adjacent residential pocket that is cleanly targetable with its own ZIP and extremely affordable EDDM economics.

EDDM Strategy for Connelly

Connelly's 12417 ZIP covers a very small residential area — an estimated 300–600 households. A full 12417 EDDM saturation is among the most affordable in Ulster County at roughly $200–$400 all-in. Because of the tiny standalone footprint, Connelly EDDM is almost always run in combination with Port Ewen (12466) and Kingston (12401 select routes) as part of a broader Rondout-Kingston waterfront corridor campaign.

Connelly has approximately 800–1,200 permanent residents and an estimated 400–600 households — a very small hamlet where EDDM is cost-effective but most meaningful as a component of a broader Kingston-area campaign.

Connelly Direct Mail FAQ

Is Connelly worth targeting separately or should I just cover it with a Kingston EDDM?

Connelly's 12417 ZIP is distinct from Kingston's 12401, so a Kingston EDDM campaign won't automatically cover Connelly households. Whether to add Connelly depends on whether your business serves that immediate riverside area. At roughly $200–$400 all-in for full 12417 saturation, adding Connelly to a Kingston campaign is inexpensive. For home service and local retail businesses along the Route 9W corridor, it's typically worth including.

Does Cornerstone serve Connelly from the New Paltz facility?

Yes. Connelly is approximately 15 miles from our New Paltz facility via Route 9W — within our standard service radius. We enter Connelly-bound EDDM at the Kingston USPS postal unit along with adjacent ZIP drops, so Connelly campaigns run on the same production and delivery schedule as Kingston campaigns. No additional logistics or timeline penalty for including Connelly in a multi-ZIP campaign.
